description: Defines the MasqueClientSession class for managing QUIC client sessions connecting to a MASQUE proxy, including interfaces for encapsulated UDP/IP sessions, and internal state management for CONNECT-UDP and CONNECT-IP requests.

classes.name: MasqueClientSession
classes.description: Manages QUIC client sessions for connecting to a MASQUE proxy, handling encapsulated UDP/IP communication, and internal state for CONNECT-UDP and CONNECT-IP requests.

classes.name: MasqueClientSession::Owner
classes.description: Interface for the owner of a MasqueClientSession, receives notifications such as settings received.

classes.name: MasqueClientSession::EncapsulatedClientSession
classes.description: Interface for encapsulated UDP client sessions within MasqueClientSession.

classes.name: MasqueClientSession::EncapsulatedIpSession
classes.description: Interface for encapsulated IP client sessions within MasqueClientSession.

classes.name: MasqueClientSession::ConnectUdpClientState
classes.description: Maintains state for each CONNECT-UDP request, including stream and encapsulated session.

classes.name: MasqueClientSession::ConnectIpClientState
classes.description: Maintains state for each CONNECT-IP request, including stream and encapsulated session.

methods.name: MasqueClientSession
methods.description: Constructor for initializing a MasqueClientSession with configuration, connection, and owner.

methods.name: GetFakeAddress
methods.description: Generates and registers a fake local address.

methods.name: RemoveFakeAddress
methods.description: Removes a previously generated fake address.
